DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。通知について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講座の紙に私の番号がありました。参加できると思いましたが、補欠という言葉の意味を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号掲載の補欠通知が参加可能か意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My number was on the course notice. I thought I could attend, but could you explain what being on the waiting list means?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the waiting-list notice showing your number means you can attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当選者ではなく、空きが出た場合の候補という案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means you are a candidate if a place opens up, rather than someone selected for a place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は参加確定ではないのですね。職場へ休みをお願いする前に、連絡が来る条件を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確定と理解し休暇依頼前に連絡条件を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So my attendance is not confirmed yet. Before asking my workplace for time off, I would like to know under what conditions I will be contacted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand attendance is unconfirmed and want to know the conditions for contact before requesting leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の連絡方法と期限をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the contact method and deadline on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話連絡とあります。連絡先を変えたので、新しい番号を担当へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知電話方式で連絡先変更を担当へ届けたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says you will call. I have changed my contact number, so I would like to give the person in charge my new number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice specifies a phone call and you want to report your changed number to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先変更を担当が確認します。補欠のままで席へ来るという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check your new contact details. Being on the waiting list does not mean you should come and take a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、勝手に参加する前提にはしません。連絡が来た時に参加できるか返事する準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確定の参加をせず連絡時に返事できるよう準備すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will not assume I can attend without confirmation. I will prepare to say whether I can attend when I am contacted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not attend without confirmation and will prepare to respond when contacted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確定の連絡内容を確認してから予定を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make your plans after checking the confirmation message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号が載っただけで当選と思わず、新しい連絡先を伝えて、参加確定の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号掲載を当選とせず更新連絡先で確定案内を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume I was selected just because my number appears. I will provide my new contact details and wait for confirmation of my attendance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that having your number listed does not mean you were selected and that you will update your contact details and await confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知を持って担当へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your notice to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。持参資料についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the documents you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬の一覧を携帯で見せたいです。ただ、前に保存した画面なので、最近変わった分が入っていないと先に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯薬一覧が旧保存で変更未反映と先に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to show my medication list on my phone. However, it is a screen I saved earlier, so I want to explain first that recent changes are not included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain first that the medication list on your phone is an old saved screen and does not reflect recent changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何が変わったか分かる資料もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you also have something showing what has changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の薬の説明紙があります。保存画面と名前が一つ違いますが、自分で同じ薬だとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現説明紙と名前一つ違い同薬か判断できないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the information sheet for my current medicine. One name differs from the saved screen, but I cannot judge for myself whether it is the same medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one name differs between the current information sheet and the saved screen and that you cannot determine whether they are the same medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つを担当へ示して、変更の時期もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show both to the person in charge and explain when the change happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 変更は先週です。古い画面を最新一覧として見せず、先週の説明紙と分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先週変更で画面を旧記録として紙と分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The change was last week. I will not present the old screen as the latest list; I will keep it separate from last week's information sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the change happened last week and you will distinguish the old screen from the information sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。今の一覧から、古い記録を勝手に消す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check. You do not need to delete old records from your current list on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。古い物は変更前の記録として残します。今日持っている紙が最新かも担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧記録保持で今の紙が最新か担当へ確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will keep the old material as a record from before the change. I will also ask whether the sheet I brought today is the latest one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will retain the old record and ask the person in charge whether your current sheet is the latest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認したい点をメモしておくと説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Writing down what you want to check will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先週の変更と、古い保存画面と今の紙の違いをメモして渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更時期と二資料差をメモして担当へ示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write down last week's change and the differences between the old saved screen and the current sheet, and hand over the note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the timing of the change and the differences between the two documents and show the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その二つを診察の担当へお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show both to the staff handling your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with your inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真で出来事を説明したいですが、携帯が名前順に並べています。先に出る写真を、先に起きた出来事として話さないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前順写真表示を出来事順と誤用せず説明したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to explain what happened using photos, but my phone sorts them by name. I want to avoid describing the photo displayed first as the event that happened first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to describe events without mistaking photos sorted by name for chronological order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮った時刻は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check when they were taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元の写真にはあります。人から送られたコピーには時刻がないので、全部を同じ順にできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自撮元データ時刻あり他人コピー時刻不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The original photos have that information. Copies sent by someone else do not have the time, so I cannot put all of them into a single chronological order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your original photos have shooting times but the copies from someone else do not. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる時刻と分からない時刻を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish known times from unknown ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の二枚は午後の時刻を示せます。送られた一枚は、受信時刻が撮影時刻とは限らないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚の撮影時刻と一枚の受信時刻を区別すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can show the afternoon shooting times for my two photos. For the one sent to me, I will explain that the receipt time is not necessarily the shooting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish the shooting times of two photos from the receipt time of the third. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その区別を保って、覚えている経緯も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keeping that distinction, we will also ask what you remember about the sequence of events.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画像名の番号で前後を作らず、私が見た時刻と資料に残る時刻を別に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画像番号で前後を作らず記憶時刻と資料時刻を分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not invent an order from the numbers in the image names. I will explain separately the times I witnessed things and the times recorded in the material.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not infer sequence from image numbers and will distinguish remembered times from recorded times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、順番を確定できない所はそのままお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please tell us where the order cannot be established.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚のうち二枚は撮影時刻あり、一枚は不明と示し、表示順を経緯として使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三枚の時刻確実性を示し表示順を経緯にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will indicate that two of the three photos have shooting times and one is unknown. I will not use their display order as the sequence of events.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the certainty of the times for the three photos and say you will not treat display order as event order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真ごとに状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask about the circumstances of each photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。差出しの準備でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you prepare your mailing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒を閉じてきたのですが、ふたが浮いています。中の書類が落ちる前に、封の仕方を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉じた封筒のふたが浮いているため書類が落ちる前に封の方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I closed this envelope before coming, but the flap is lifting. Could you check how to seal it before the documents inside fall out?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the flap of your closed envelope is lifting and ask how to seal it before the documents fall out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ふたの細い保護紙がまだ付いていますね。この封筒は、そこをはがして接着面を出す物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The narrow protective strip is still on the flap. With this envelope, you peel it off to expose the adhesive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 折れば閉じると思っていました。この細い紙を宛名ラベルだと思って残しましたが、接着面のカバーなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 細い紙を宛名ラベルと思った誤解を説明し接着面の保護紙だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought folding it would close it. I left this narrow strip because I thought it was an address label, but it is the adhesive cover, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the narrow strip for an address label and confirm that it protects the adhesive. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。はがす前に、中へ入れる書類がそろっているかも確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Before peeling it off, also check that all the documents you need are inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類二枚と返信の案内一枚が入っています。抜けはありません。ここで保護紙をはがして、ふたを押さえて閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類二枚と案内一枚の不足がないと伝え保護紙をはがして封をすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two documents and one sheet of reply instructions inside. Nothing is missing. I will peel off the protective strip here and press the flap down to seal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the two documents and one instruction sheet are all inside and say you will remove the strip and seal the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封ができましたね。はがした紙は、封筒へ一緒に貼らずに片付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is sealed now. Please dispose of the strip you removed instead of sticking it onto the envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙はごみとして片付けます。ふたは浮かなくなりました。切手と宛名は表にあり、ふたの接着面には触れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保護紙を片付けふたが閉じ宛名切手の位置も保たれていると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will throw the strip away. The flap is no longer lifting. The stamp and address are on the front and do not touch the flap's adhesive area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you have disposed of the strip, the flap is closed, and the stamp and address remain correctly positioned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では封筒の宛名と料金を確認します。ほかに入れ忘れはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Now I will check the address and postage. Have you forgotten to put anything else in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。書類と案内がそろい、ふたも閉じたので、この一通をお願いします。教えていただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容物と封を確認した一通の引受けを頼み案内への礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. The documents and instructions are all inside and the flap is closed, so please accept this envelope. Thank you for showing me how.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask staff to accept the envelope after checking its contents and seal, and thank them for their guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一通をお預かりします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will take this envelope. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。控えについて何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about your copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙に金額を書いてもらいました。入金の相談予約の控えですが、家族へ入金済みと見せる前に内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金額入り相談予約控えを入金済証拠とする前に意味確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone wrote an amount on this paper. It is my copy of a consultation appointment about a deposit, but I want to check what it means before showing my family that the money has been deposited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the meaning of a consultation appointment slip showing an amount before treating it as proof of a completed deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は相談の予定で、入金の手続きはしていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: At present you only have a consultation scheduled; you have not made the deposit, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。来週持ってくる予定の金額が書いてあります。受け付けた金額かと思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入金未実施で来週予定額を受付済金額と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. It shows the amount I plan to bring next week. I mistakenly thought it was the amount you had already accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that no deposit has been made and that you mistook next week's planned amount for an amount already received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予定額と、実際に受け付けた取引を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish a planned amount from a transaction that has actually been accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族には来週の相談用メモだと伝えます。今日口座へ入った金額としては報告しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ予定メモと伝え今日の入金報告にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell my family it is a note for next week's consultation. I will not report it as money deposited into the account today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will explain to your family that it is a planning note, not a record of today's deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引の確認には、手続き後の記録を使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: To confirm a transaction, please use the record issued after the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。来週の相談では、この紙の予定額と実際に持参する額が同じかも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週予定額と実持参額の一致も担当へ伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. At next week's consultation, I will also explain whether the amount planned on this paper matches the amount I actually bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will also tell the staff next week whether the planned amount and the amount you bring match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定が変われば、その旨を担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your plans change, please let the person in charge know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の紙は予約控えとして保管し、入金したという報告は実際の手続きと記録を確認してからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約控え保持で実手続記録確認後に入金報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep this paper as an appointment slip and report that the deposit was made only after checking the actual procedure and its record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will retain the appointment slip and report a deposit only after checking the actual transaction and record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご予約の日にお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We look forward to seeing you on your appointment day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この桃を柔らかいか確かめようとして押してしまいました。跡が付いたので、棚へ戻さずお知らせしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 押して跡が付いた桃を棚へ戻さず申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I pressed this peach to check whether it was soft. It left a mark, so I want to tell you rather than put it back on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you pressed a peach and marked it, without returning it to the shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 押した物は、今どれでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一個です。ほかの桃には触っていません。外から見える跡は指で押した所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一個のみ押し他桃未接触で指の跡と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. I have not touched the other peaches. The mark visible from outside is where I pressed it with my finger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you pressed only one peach, did not touch the others, and left a finger mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を確認します。ご自身で傷のないように並べ直さず、お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check its condition. Please bring it to us rather than rearranging it yourself to make it look undamaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。裏へ向けて跡を隠すことはしません。私が押したと分かるように説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏向けで跡を隠さず自分の行為を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not turn it over to hide the mark. I will explain clearly that I pressed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not hide the mark by turning it over and will explain what you did. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 選ぶ時に迷ったら、触り方や状態を店員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are unsure when choosing fruit, ask a staff member about its condition and how to handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次は自分で強く押さず、今日食べたいことを伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回は押さず今日食べたい目的で店員へ選び方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next time I will not press hard myself. I will explain that I want to eat it today and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask staff how to choose a peach to eat today instead of pressing it next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回はこの桃の状態を見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: For now, we will check this peach and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一個の跡は私が付けた物です。棚へ戻すか買うかを自分で決めず、案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己判断で戻す購入を決めず申告して案内を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I made the mark on this peach. I will listen to your guidance instead of deciding for myself whether to return it to the shelf or buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report what happened and follow guidance rather than decide on your own whether to return or buy it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check its condition here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の集合でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble finding your group in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩の会に来ましたが、黄色い旗の団体が二つあります。色だけで合流せず、私の会を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黄色旗二団体を色だけで選ばず散歩会を確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came for a walking event, but there are two groups with yellow flags. I would like to check which is mine rather than join based on color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to identify your walking event without choosing between two yellow-flag groups by color alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内に会の名前はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your information give the group's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自然観察の会とあります。先に見た旗には歩こう会と書いてあり、名前が違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人案内自然観察と見た旗歩こう会の名が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says Nature Observation Group. The first flag I saw said Walking Group, so the name was different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your information says Nature Observation Group while the flag you saw says Walking Group. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加案内の会名と集合地点を照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please compare the group name and meeting point with your participation information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の案内は池の手前です。歩こう会は出口で待っているので、同じ色でも別の集まりですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 池手前と出口の集合差で別会と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My information says before the pond. The Walking Group is waiting at the exit, so even with the same color, they are different gatherings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the meeting points before the pond and at the exit identify different groups. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会の担当者にもご自身の参加案内を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also show your participation information to the group's organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、見つけた団体の出発に合わせて勝手についていかず、自然観察の会へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無確認で他団体へ付いていかず本人会の担当へ案内を示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not simply follow the group I found when it leaves. I will check with the Nature Observation Group.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will show your information to your own organizer rather than follow another group without checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 池の手前の集合場所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The meeting point before the pond is this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と場所を確認できました。旗の色だけでなく会名を見て、担当へ参加を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前場所で正しい集合へ行き担当へ参加を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed the name and location. I will check the group name, not just the flag color, and tell the organizer I am attending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will go to the correct meeting point after checking the name and location and tell the organizer you are attending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞ集合場所へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please proceed to the meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with the trains?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 運休の通知が来ました。路線全体だと思いましたが、区間名があるので、私の予定にも関係するか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 区間付き運休通知が自分の予定へ関係するか照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a service suspension notice. I thought it meant the whole line, but it names a section, so I want to check whether it affects my plans too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the section in the suspension notice with your own travel plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこからどこまで乗る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where do you plan to travel from and to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅から友人の住む駅までです。通知の区間は、その先の二駅の間になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車区間と通知のさらに先二駅区間の差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: From this station to the station where my friend lives. The section in the notice is between two stations farther along the line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your journey and the two-station section farther along mentioned in the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示区間だけでなく、利用する便への影響も係員と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with staff not only the listed section but also any effect on the train you will use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、区間が違うから必ず平常とも決めません。私の出発時刻と降りる駅を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間違いでも影響なしとせず便時刻降車駅を示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not assume everything is normal just because the section differs. I will show my departure time and destination station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will show your train time and destination without assuming a different section means no impact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご利用便の案内を確認します。通知はいつ届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the information for your train. When did the notice arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝ですが、更新されているかもしれません。保存した通知だけでなく、今の案内も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 朝の保存通知だけでなく現在更新を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This morning, but it may have been updated. I want to check the current information as well as the notice I saved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check current updates in addition to this morning's saved notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の案内をご説明しますので、こちらの表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the current information. Please look at this display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知の区間と私の便を分けて確認します。古い通知だけで全部運休とも全く影響なしとも判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区間と利用便を分け全休影響なし双方を未確認で判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the notified section and my train separately. I will not conclude from an old notice alone either that all services are suspended or that there is no effect at all.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the section and your train separately without assuming either complete suspension or no effect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご利用便から確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us start by checking the train you will use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行事の準備で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the event preparations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域の案内を母語でも説明する手伝いをします。チラシに講師として私の名前がありましたが、講座を教える役ではないので直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付言語支援を講師と掲載されたチラシの役割訂正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am helping explain the local information in my native language too. The flyer lists me as an instructor, but I am not teaching the course, so I would like that corrected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to correct a flyer that lists your reception language-support role as an instructor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご担当は、どの場面の説明でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: At which stage are you responsible for explaining things?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付で案内文の意味を伝える役です。講座の内容を教えるのは、別の先生です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付案内翻訳役で授業担当は別先生と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My role is to explain what the information text means at reception. A different teacher will teach the course content.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you translate reception information and a different teacher is responsible for the class. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当名と役割を分けて、作成者へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish the person's name from their role and check with the creator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の名前を全部消すのではなく、受付の言語支援として記載できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前削除でなく受付言語支援として表示できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than remove my name entirely, I would like to ask whether I can be listed as providing language support at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can be listed as reception language support instead of having your name removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が表現を確認します。講座内容への質問が来たらどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the wording. What will you do if you receive questions about the course content?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけで答えず、講師へ取り次ぎます。受付の手順の説明と講座の専門内容を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 専門質問は講師へ取り次ぎ受付手順と授業内容を分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will refer them to the instructor rather than answer on my own. I will distinguish explaining reception procedures from explaining the course's specialist content.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will refer specialist questions to the instructor and distinguish reception procedures from class content. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その役割をチラシ作成者にもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain that role to the flyer creator too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付の言語支援で、講師ではないと伝えます。印刷前に修正した役割名を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 印刷前に非講師の修正役割表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I provide language support at reception, not instruction. I will check the corrected role description before printing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the corrected role description, showing you are not an instructor, before printing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。作成の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person creating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。持参メモでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the notes you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体温を二回測りました。平均だけを書きましたが、朝と昼で違ったので、それぞれの値を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 平均だけでなく朝昼別体温を伝えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took my temperature twice. I wrote only the average, but the morning and noon readings differed, so I would like to report each value.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to report your morning and noon temperatures separately rather than only their average. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 測った時刻と数字は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the measurement times and numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝七時は三十六・五度、昼十二時は三十七・五度です。平均を三十七度と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 七時三十六・五と十二時三十七・五で平均三十七と記載したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At seven in the morning it was 36.5 degrees, and at noon it was 37.5. I wrote the average as 37 degrees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the readings were 36.5 at seven and 37.5 at noon, with an average of 37 recorded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その平均を、一回の測定値として伝えないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us make sure you do not report that average as a single measured reading.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 平均と書き添えて、朝と昼の値も出します。三十七度を実際に測ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十七は実測でなく平均と明記して二値も示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will label it as an average and also provide the morning and noon values. I did not actually measure 37 degrees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will identify 37 as an average rather than an actual reading and provide both measurements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 測り方など、担当が確認したいことも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also ask about anything the staff wish to check, such as how you measured it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二回とも同じ体温計です。ただ、測った場所は家と職場で違います。その点も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同機器だが家職場別場所で測ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I used the same thermometer both times. However, the locations differed: home and work. I will explain that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you used the same thermometer but measured at different locations, home and work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 測定メモを担当へお示しください。値の意味は診察の担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show your measurement notes to the staff. The clinical staff will check what the values mean.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二回の時刻、値、場所を分けて伝えます。平均だけで私の状態を説明したことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻値場所を分け診察担当へ示し平均のみを状態説明にしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the time, value, and location of each measurement separately. I will not treat the average alone as an explanation of my condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give clinical staff the times, values, and locations separately rather than explain your condition only with the average. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。メモをお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait with your notes ready.
